about: Probe set from the 28 Nov 2026 Hopper MCP stress test (HOP-81). Rerun after every hopper-mcp change with tests/search_probes.py. Automated probes call one read tool and check the result; manual probes need a save or a share and are checked by hand.

probes.name: Case study structure finds captured pages

args.query: case study page structure: section order, navigation
competitor pricing page onboarding flow landing page comparison

probes.name: Tone of voice: nothing, or only voice and copy notes

args.query: tone of voice microcopy writing style
usability heuristics information architecture navigation wireframe

probes.name: Oak panel teardown: only teardown notes
Tall page as legible tiles
probes.manual: get_reference role=full-page on a page over 10,000px: expect tiles at native width, one per section.

probes.name: Airbnb open search sheet
probes.manual: get_note on the Airbnb teardown: expect the open Where/When/Who sheet as a state frame.

probes.name: Cheap tier for quotes and articles
probes.manual: Save a quote and an article: expect the cheap tier only. Save a competitor page with a layout reason: expect the heavy tier with no flag passed.

probes.name: Ask once when the reason is missing
probes.manual: Save via the MCP with no stated reason: expect Claude to ask once for medium, borrow and reason, not guess.

probes.name: Bare illustration from Keep
probes.manual: Share a bare illustration: expect image x illustration, marked inferred, no DOM work.

probes.name: Print pages, small result
probes.depends_on: print-page medium being set (HOP-69 routing, or a re-read)

probes.name: Bare palette card
probes.manual: Share a bare palette card: expect image x palette, not other.

probes.name: Printable worksheet thumbnail
probes.manual: Share a printable worksheet thumbnail: expect image x mockup, not documentation.

probes.name: Hopper's own UI is not a reference

args.query: dark masonry board of saved notes with search bar and project tabs
